input.summary: Settled 13 of 17 real Elden Ring controls from clear majorities in their own history (crouch, lock-on, guard, skill, dodge, item use, interact, weapon/spell/item switching, menu, map). Asked 4 questions where their history splits close to evenly between genuinely different playstyles: forward/backward movement (breath-latch vs joystick tilt) and light/strong attack (which mouth action to use). The remaining 13 rows (kb_a, kb_c, kb_e, kb_f, kb_f1, kb_h, kb_left_control, kb_left_shift, kb_q, kb_s, kb_w, kb_x, mouse_right_button) have no documented function in Elden Ring's sourced control list, so each was bound to their dominant cross-game habit for that exact key/output as an inferred, low-risk default that preserves muscle memory if the game does use it and does nothing if it doesn't.
